propositions: Jira writes across multiple dispatch paths (Cloud ACLI/REST, DC SDK) can multiply under timeout or leave acceptance ambiguous; a provider-neutral operation/outcome contract with stable logical id, desired postcondition, invocation budget, and replay safety is required.

Retry budget is bounded to three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep with exponential backoff [2s,3s) then [4s,5s); provider Retry-After parsed by _errors.parse_retry_after acts as lower bound.
Cloud executor makes one ACLI process per write, decodes sanitized exit/stdout/stderr, and recovery uses primary-store GET via acli_rest._rest_urlopen_with_retry with one-attempt/no-sleep policy.
DC executor uses jira.JIRA with max_retries=0 and fails fast unless _session.max_retries == 0; summary-write invocation is exactly GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats.
Desired postcondition observed after timeout indicates recovered success; inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown; over-budget delay returns retry_not_before without sleep.

Every terminal outcome or cleanup failure emits exactly one completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points; total log at most 1024 code points.
